integrity: Exact analytical proof of sharp range, equality, spectrum realization, Gram defect and sharp stability exponent; accompanying independent moment enumeration and seeded sampling are finite diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: Only nondegenerate Euclidean simplices in integer dimension at least three, with independent volume-uniform points. The upper endpoint is a degenerate limit. The explicit rigidity prefactor is not claimed optimal, while the square-root exponent is sharp. Historical priority is provisional; independent assessment not performed.
title: Sharp distance-moment spectrum and stability of Euclidean simplices
